arms.better: The run found the relevant implementation, but spent 2.53M input tokens rereading/searching the same model and utility paths and then ended with ‘model ended turn without submitting’; the retry advice did not explain the underlying failure or make the expensive attempt's state/usage actionable. A narrower plan and better run-failure diagnostics should help users decide whether to retry or inspect provider/model behavior. The requested bare `tm events` command only printed usage, so event capture requires discovering the `tail` subcommand despite the command overview calling it the event-log surface.

The agent stated a scoped plan, found the stream check quickly, changed it to `hasattr(data, "__iter__")`, and added a delegated-wrapper regression test. Its own test attempts initially lacked the project package/dependencies and it accurately disclosed that limitation; after setup was corrected, the hidden PR test passed. It could be better by using the prepared environment's interpreter/PYTHONPATH and installing the repository's test extras before reporting test coverage, rather than treating the first import errors as the final verification attempt.
